note: feat/collection-currency-choice: a payment request may be raised in ILS / USD / EUR, limited to what the selected provider supports — only while the fail-closed kill switch DUBIZ_FX_COLLECTION_ENABLED is exactly "true" (default OFF: ILS only). ILS stays the default and ILS requests are unchanged; invoice-backed requests keep the invoice currency.

lib/services/payments/payment-currency-o.reason: pure (no DB/network) currency authority for payment requests. Switch OFF (default, DUBIZ_FX_COLLECTION_ENABLED unset or anything but the exact string true): ILS alone offered for every provider, any non-ILS (sent or invoice-derived) refused FOREIGN_CURRENCY_COLLECTION_DISABLED before any row/audit/provider call (provider calls counted), ILS output identical OFF vs ON. Switch ON (on a CardCom PROVIDER_ISSUES connection — the only collector a foreign currency is allowed for; DUBIZ_ISSUES readiness stays ILS alone): Dubiz set (ILS/USD/EUR) intersected with each real adapter set (CardCom ILS/USD/EUR, SUMIT ILS/USD, Tranzila ILS/USD/EUR, PayPal pass-through), refusal before any row/audit/provider call, invoice-backed requests held to the invoice currency, readiness offerableCurrencies, he/en refusal messages

components/collection/new/collection-cur.reason: pure: /collection/new currency choice — ILS-only identity (currency derivation equals the pre-change expression for every input and the choice renders no markup), invoice-backed requests never offer a choice, standalone requests preselect ILS and use the pick; rendered with react-dom/server
